+"""The `extract-variable` and `extract-function` commands."""

+import ast

+import os

+

+from .errors import SithError

+from .refactoring import (Refactoring, Source, apply_edits, check_identifier, dump,

+                          replaced_tree, same_tree)

+

+_SCOPES = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef, ast.Lambda)

+_FUNCTIONS = (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)

+_COMPREHENSIONS = (ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp, ast.DictComp, ast.GeneratorExp)

+_INDENT = "    "

+

+

+def _identifier_char(char):

+    return char == "_" or char.isalnum()

+

+

+def _selection(source, start, until):

+    """Absolute (start, end) offsets of the selection, with surrounding whitespace trimmed."""

+    for line, col in (start, until):

+        if not 1 <= line <= len(source.lines):

+            raise SithError(f"line {line} is out of range (file has {len(source.lines)} lines)")

+        if col < 0:

+            raise SithError(f"column {col} is out of range")

+    text = source.text

+    begin = source.offset(start[0], min(start[1], len(source.lines[start[0] - 1])))

+    end = source.offset(until[0], min(until[1], len(source.lines[until[0] - 1])))

+    if end < begin:

+        raise SithError("the selection ends before it starts")

+    # An end inside an identifier or number is taken to include it (an inclusive end column).

+    if begin < end < len(text) and _identifier_char(text[end - 1]) and _identifier_char(text[end]):

+        while end < len(text) and _identifier_char(text[end]):

+            end += 1

+    while begin < end and text[begin].isspace():

+        begin += 1

+    while end > begin and text[end - 1].isspace():

+        end -= 1

+    if begin == end:

+        raise SithError("the selection is empty")

+    return begin, end

+

+

+def _ancestors(source, node):

+    parent = source.parent(node)

+    while parent is not None:

+        yield parent

+        parent = source.parent(parent)

+

+

+def _statement_of(source, node):

+    for ancestor in _ancestors(source, node):

+        if isinstance(ancestor, ast.stmt):

+            return ancestor

+    return None

+

+

+# -- extract variable ----------------------------------------------------------------

+

+def extract_variable(path, start, until, name, project=None):

+    check_identifier(name, "--name")

+    source = Source(path)

+    begin, end = _selection(source, start, until)

+    node, begin, end = _expression_at(source, begin, end)

+    statement = _statement_of(source, node)

+    _check_extractable(source, node, statement)

+    text = source.text

+    expression = text[source.start(node):source.end(node)]

+    # The replacement, dropping parentheses that only grouped the extracted expression.

+    expected = dump(replaced_tree(source.tree, {id(node): ast.Name(id=name, ctx=ast.Load())}))

+    replace = (begin, end)

+    outer_begin, outer_end = begin, end

+    while True:

+        before = text[:outer_begin].rstrip()

+        after = text[outer_end:].lstrip()

+        if not (before.endswith("(") and after.startswith(")")):

+            break

+        outer_begin, outer_end = len(before) - 1, len(text) - len(after) + 1

+        if same_tree(text[:outer_begin] + name + text[outer_end:], expected):

+            replace = (outer_begin, outer_end)

+    assignment = f"{name} = {expression}"

+    value_dump = dump(node)

+    try:

+        parsed = ast.parse(assignment)

+        valid = len(parsed.body) == 1 and dump(parsed.body[0].value) == value_dump

+    except (SyntaxError, ValueError):

+        valid = False

+    if not valid:

+        assignment = f"{name} = ({expression})"

+    edits = [(replace[0], replace[1], name), _insertion(source, statement, assignment)]

+    refactoring = Refactoring(project or os.path.dirname(source.path))

+    refactoring.change(source.path, text, apply_edits(text, edits))

+    return refactoring

+

+

+def _expression_at(source, begin, end):

+    """The expression node spanning exactly [begin, end), allowing enclosing parentheses."""

+    spans = {}

+    for node in ast.walk(source.tree):

+        if isinstance(node, ast.expr):

+            spans.setdefault((source.start(node), source.end(node)), node)

+    text = source.text

+    inner_begin, inner_end = begin, end

+    while True:

+        node = spans.get((inner_begin, inner_end))

+        if node is not None:

+            return node, begin, end

+        if text[inner_begin] == "(" and text[inner_end - 1] == ")" and \

+                _matching_paren(text, inner_begin) == inner_end - 1:

+            inner_begin += 1

+            inner_end -= 1

+            while inner_begin < inner_end and text[inner_begin].isspace():

+                inner_begin += 1

+            while inner_end > inner_begin and text[inner_end - 1].isspace():

+                inner_end -= 1

+            continue

+        raise SithError("selection is not a complete expression")

+

+

+def _matching_paren(text, index):

+    depth = 0

+    quote = None

+    i = index

+    while i < len(text):

+        char = text[i]

+        if quote:

+            if char == "\\":

+                i += 1

+            elif text.startswith(quote, i):

+                i += len(quote) - 1

+                quote = None

+        elif char in "\"'":

+            quote = char * 3 if text.startswith(char * 3, i) else char

+            i += len(quote) - 1

+        elif char == "#":

+            newline = text.find("\n", i)

+            i = len(text) if newline < 0 else newline

+            continue

+        elif char in "([{":

+            depth += 1

+        elif char in ")]}":

+            depth -= 1

+            if depth == 0:

+                return i

+        i += 1

+    return None

+

+

+def _check_extractable(source, node, statement):

+    parent = source.parent(node)

+    in_format = isinstance(parent, ast.JoinedStr) or \

+        isinstance(parent, ast.FormattedValue) and node is parent.format_spec

+    if statement is None or in_format or isinstance(node, (ast.Starred, ast.Slice)):

+        raise SithError("selection is not a complete expression")

+    if not isinstance(getattr(node, "ctx", ast.Load()), ast.Load):

+        raise SithError("cannot extract an assignment target")

+    if isinstance(parent, ast.comprehension) and node is parent.target:

+        raise SithError("cannot extract an assignment target")

+    names = {n.id for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)}

+    for ancestor in _ancestors(source, node):

+        if ancestor is statement:

+            break

+        bound = set()

+        if isinstance(ancestor, ast.Lambda):

+            bound = {a.arg for a in _arguments(ancestor.args)}

+        elif isinstance(ancestor, _COMPREHENSIONS):

+            for generator in ancestor.generators:

+                bound |= {n.id for n in ast.walk(generator.target) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)}

+        if names & bound:

+            raise SithError("cannot extract an expression that uses names bound inside it "

+                            "(lambda parameters or comprehension variables)")

+            any(statement is s for s in getattr(source.parent(statement), "orelse", [])) and \

+            source.text[source.start(statement):].startswith("elif") and \

+            _within(source, node, statement.test):

+        raise SithError("cannot extract from an elif condition")

+

+

+def _within(source, node, container):

+    return source.start(container) <= source.start(node) and \

+        source.end(node) <= source.end(container)

+

+

+def _arguments(arguments):

+    params = arguments.posonlyargs + arguments.args + arguments.kwonlyargs

+    return params + [a for a in (arguments.vararg, arguments.kwarg) if a is not None]

+

+

+def _first_line(statement):

+    decorators = getattr(statement, "decorator_list", None) or []

+    return min([statement.lineno] + [d.lineno for d in decorators])

+

+

+def _insertion(source, statement, code):

+    """An edit inserting the one-line statement `code` just before `statement`."""

+    line = _first_line(statement)

+    start = source.offset(line, 0)

+    first = source.start(statement) if line == statement.lineno else start

+    prefix = source.text[start:first]

+    if prefix.strip():  # after `;` or a block header on the same line

+        return first, first, f"{code}; "

+    return start, start, f"{prefix}{code}\n"

+

+

+# -- extract function ----------------------------------------------------------------

+

+def extract_function(path, start, until, name, project=None):

+    check_identifier(name, "--name")

+    source = Source(path)

+    begin, end = _selection(source, start, until)

+    text = source.text

+    remainder = text[end:text.find("\n", end) if "\n" in text[end:] else len(text)]

+    if len(remainder.strip()) == 1:  # an inclusive end column on the last character

+        end += len(remainder.rstrip())

+    # Whole lines: only whitespace before the selection and whitespace or a comment after it.

+    line_start = text.rfind("\n", 0, begin) + 1

+    line_end = text.find("\n", end)

+    line_end = len(text) if line_end < 0 else line_end

+    if text[line_start:begin].strip():

+        raise SithError("selection does not span complete statements")

+    statements = _selected_statements(source, begin, end)

+    trailing = text[source.end(statements[-1]):line_end].strip()

+    if trailing and not trailing.startswith("#"):

+        raise SithError("selection does not span complete statements")

+    analysis = _Analysis(source, scope, statements, begin, end)

+    first_indent = source.indent_of(statements[0].lineno)

+    body_lines = text[line_start:line_end].split("\n")

+    is_async = analysis.awaits

+

+    params = list(analysis.parameters)

+    returns = [] if analysis.ends_with_return else list(analysis.returns)

+    decorator = ""

+    receiver = ""

+    in_module = isinstance(scope, ast.Module)

+    if in_module:

+        indent = first_indent

+        insert_at = line_start

+    else:

+        indent = source.indent_of(_first_line(scope))

+        insert_at = source.offset(_first_line(scope), 0)

+        container = source.parent(scope)

+        if isinstance(scope, _FUNCTIONS) and isinstance(container, ast.ClassDef):

+            decorators = {d.id for d in scope.decorator_list if isinstance(d, ast.Name)}

+            if "staticmethod" in decorators:

+                decorator = "@staticmethod"

+                receiver = container.name + "."

+            else:

+                arguments = scope.args.posonlyargs + scope.args.args

+                if arguments:

+                    first = arguments[0].arg

+                    params = [first] + [p for p in params if p != first]

+                    receiver = first + "."

+                if "classmethod" in decorators:

+                    decorator = "@classmethod"

+    body = []

+    for line in body_lines:

+        if line.startswith(first_indent):

+            body.append(body_indent + line[len(first_indent):] if line.strip() else "")

+        else:

+            body.append(line if not line.strip() else body_indent + line.lstrip())

+    if returns:

+        body.append(f"{body_indent}return {', '.join(returns)}")

+    separator = "\n\n\n" if not indent else "\n\n"

+    function_code = "\n".join(function_lines) + separator

+

+    call_arguments = [p for p in params if not (receiver and p == params[0] and

+                                                 p + "." == receiver)]

+    call = f"{'await ' if is_async else ''}{receiver}{name}({', '.join(call_arguments)})"

+    if analysis.ends_with_return:

+        call_line = f"{first_indent}return {call}"

+    elif returns:

+        call_line = f"{first_indent}{', '.join(returns)} = {call}"

+    else:

+        call_line = f"{first_indent}{call}"

+    if in_module:

+        edits = [(line_start, line_end, function_code + call_line)]

+    else:

+        edits = [(insert_at, insert_at, function_code), (line_start, line_end, call_line)]

+    refactoring = Refactoring(project or os.path.dirname(source.path))

+    refactoring.change(source.path, text, apply_edits(text, edits))

+    return refactoring

+

+

+def _selected_statements(source, begin, end):

+    """The consecutive sibling statements covering exactly the selection."""

+    selected = []

+    for node in ast.walk(source.tree):

+        if not isinstance(node, ast.stmt):

+            continue

+        node_start, node_end = source.start(node), source.end(node)

+        if node_end <= begin or node_start >= end:

+            continue

+        if node_start <= begin and node_end >= end and not (node_start == begin and

+                                                            node_end == end):

+            continue  # encloses the selection

+        if begin <= node_start and node_end <= end:

+            selected.append(node)

+            continue

+    top = [node for node in selected if not any(id(a) in ids for a in _ancestors(source, node))]

+    if not top:

+        raise SithError("selection does not contain any statement")

+    parent = source.parent(top[0])

+    for field in ("body", "orelse", "finalbody"):

+        body = getattr(parent, field, None)

+        if isinstance(body, list) and any(s is top[0] for s in body):

+            index = next(i for i, s in enumerate(body) if s is top[0])

+            if body[index:index + len(top)] == top:

+        bodies = [handler.body for handler in getattr(parent, "handlers", [])]

+        bodies += [case.body for case in getattr(parent, "cases", [])]

+        for body in bodies:

+            if any(s is top[0] for s in body):

+                index = next(i for i, s in enumerate(body) if s is top[0])

+                if body[index:index + len(top)] == top:

+        if any(line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith("#") and line.strip() != ";"

+            raise SithError("selection does not span complete statements")

+

+        return asdict(self)

+    collector = _Collector(lines, text.split("\n"))

+    with warnings.catch_warnings():

+        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

+        collector.run()

+    if "\0" in text and not collector.errors:

+        line = text[:text.index("\0")].count("\n") + 1

+        column = len(text[:text.index("\0")].split("\n")[-1])

+        collector.errors.append(SyntaxErrorReport(

+            line, column, line, column + 1, "source code cannot contain null bytes"))

+        super().__init__(lines, None)

+        self.touched.update(index + 1 for index, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before, self.state))

+                            if old != new)

+    def _record(self, error):

+        lines = self.original_lines

+        count = len(lines)

+        line = getattr(error, "lineno", None) or count

+        offset = getattr(error, "offset", None) or 1

+        if line > count:

+            line = count

+            offset = len(lines[-1]) + 1

+                "expected an indented block" in str(getattr(error, "msg", "")):

+            return

+        column = max(0, min(offset - 1, length))

+        until_line = getattr(error, "end_lineno", None) or line

+        end_offset = getattr(error, "end_offset", None)

+        if until_line < line or until_line > count:

+            until_line = line

+        if end_offset is None or end_offset <= 0:

+            until_column = column

+        else:

+            until_column = min(end_offset - 1, len(lines[until_line - 1]))

+        if (until_line, until_column) <= (line, column):

+            until_line, until_column = line, min(column + 1, length) if length > column else column

+        message = str(getattr(error, "msg", None) or error)

+        self.errors.append(SyntaxErrorReport(line, column, until_line, until_column, message))

+from .references import PROJECT, search_references

+from .scopes import Binding

+from .values import LocalModule

+

+def inline(path, line, col, project=None):

+    if occurrence.kind in ("constant", "text"):

+        raise SithError(f"no name at line {line}, column {col}")

+    name = occurrence.name

+    binding = _definition(search)

+    sources = {}

+

+        if file_path not in sources:

+            sources[file_path] = Source(file_path)

+        return sources[file_path]

+

+    definition_source = source_for(binding.scope.module.path)

+    statement = _strict_node(definition_source, binding.node)

+    if statement is None:

+        raise SithError(f"cannot find the definition of {name!r}")

+    value = statement.value

+    target = statement.target if isinstance(statement, ast.AnnAssign) else statement.targets[0]

+    value_text = definition_source.segment(value)

+    free_names = any(isinstance(node, ast.Name) for node in ast.walk(value))

+    references = []  # (source, node to replace)

+    imports = []  # (source, alias node) of `from ... import name` in other modules

+    for match in search.matches:

+        found = match.occurrence

+        current = source_for(match.path)

+        node = _strict_occurrence(current, match.line, found)

+        if node is target:

+        if node is None:

+            raise SithError(f"cannot inline {name!r}: unsupported use at "

+                            f"{match.module_path}:{match.line}:{found.start}")

+            statement_node = current.parent(node)

+            if node.asname or not isinstance(statement_node, ast.ImportFrom) \

+                    or current is definition_source:

+                raise SithError(f"cannot inline {name!r}: it is imported at "

+                                f"{match.module_path}:{match.line}")

+            imports.append((current, node))

+            continue

+        context = getattr(node, "ctx", None)

+        if not isinstance(context, ast.Load):

+            raise SithError(f"cannot inline {name!r}: it is assigned or deleted more than once "

+                            f"({match.module_path}:{match.line})")

+        if current is not definition_source and free_names:

+            raise SithError(f"cannot inline {name!r} into another module: "

+                            "its value depends on other names")

+        references.append((current, node))

+        raise SithError("name has no references to inline")

+                 candidate.end_col_offset) == \

+                (node.lineno, node.col_offset, node.end_lineno, node.end_col_offset):

+            return candidate

+    return None

+    name = occurrence.name

+    start = occurrence.start

+    for node in ast.walk(source.tree):

+        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):

+            if node.id == name and node.lineno == line and \

+                    source.char_col(line, node.col_offset) == start:

+                return node

+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):

+            if node.attr == name and node.end_lineno == line and \

+                    source.char_col(line, node.end_col_offset) == start + len(name):

+                return node

+        elif isinstance(node, ast.alias):

+            if node.lineno == line and source.char_col(line, node.col_offset) == start and \

+                    (node.asname or node.name) == name:

+                return node

+    return None

+

+def _replacement(source, node, value, value_text, start, end):

+    """`value_text`, parenthesized when the code around `node` would otherwise change meaning."""

+    expected = dump(replaced_tree(source.tree, {id(node): value}))

+    for candidate in (value_text, f"({value_text})"):

+        if same_tree(source.text[:start] + candidate + source.text[end:], expected):

+            return candidate

+    return f"({value_text})"

+

+

+def _removal(source, statement):

+    """An edit deleting `statement` (replaced by `pass` when it is a block's only statement)."""

+    start, end = source.start(statement), source.end(statement)

+    text = source.text

+    parent = source.parent(statement)

+    siblings = None

+    for field in ("body", "orelse", "finalbody", "handlers"):

+        body = getattr(parent, field, None)

+        if isinstance(body, list) and any(s is statement for s in body):

+            siblings = body

+    if siblings is not None and len(siblings) == 1 and not isinstance(parent, ast.Module):

+        return start, end, "pass"

+    line_start = text.rfind("\n", 0, start) + 1

+    line_end = text.find("\n", end)

+    line_end = len(text) if line_end < 0 else line_end

+    before = text[line_start:start]

+    after = text[end:line_end]

+    stripped_after = after.lstrip(" \t")

+    if stripped_after.startswith(";"):

+        following = end + (len(after) - len(stripped_after)) + 1

+        while following < line_end and text[following] in " \t":

+            following += 1

+        if before.strip() or following < line_end and text[following] != "#":

+            return start, following, ""

+        stripped_after = text[following:line_end]

+    if before.strip():

+        semicolon = text.rfind(";", line_start, start)

+        if semicolon >= 0 and not text[semicolon + 1:start].strip():

+            return semicolon, end, ""

+        return start, end, "pass"

+    if stripped_after and not stripped_after.startswith("#"):

+        return start, end, "pass"

+    return line_start, min(line_end + 1, len(text)), ""

+

+

+def _import_removal(source, alias):

+    """An edit removing `alias` from its `from ... import` statement."""

+    statement = source.parent(alias)

+    remaining = [a for a in statement.names if a is not alias]

+    if not remaining:

+        return _removal(source, statement)

+    names = ", ".join(a.name + (f" as {a.asname}" if a.asname else "") for a in remaining)

+    module = "." * statement.level + (statement.module or "")

+    return source.start(statement), source.end(statement), f"from {module} import {names}"

+class Refactoring:

+    """The outcome of a refactoring: new file contents and renamed paths."""

+

+    def __init__(self, root):

+        self.root = os.path.abspath(root)

+        self.old_texts = {}  # absolute path -> original text

+        self.new_texts = {}  # absolute path -> new text

+        self.renames = []  # (old absolute path, new absolute path)

+

+    def change(self, path, old_text, new_text):

+        path = os.path.abspath(path)

+        self.old_texts.setdefault(path, old_text)

+        self.new_texts[path] = new_text

+

+    def rename(self, old_path, new_path):

+        self.renames.append((os.path.abspath(old_path), os.path.abspath(new_path)))

+

+    def relative(self, path):

+        relative = os.path.relpath(path, self.root)

+        if relative == os.pardir or relative.startswith(os.pardir + os.sep):

+            return posix_path(path)

+        return posix_path(relative)

+

+    def moved(self, path):

+        """Where the file at `path` ends up once the renames are applied."""

+        for old, new in self.renames:

+            if path == old:

+                return new

+            if path.startswith(old + os.sep):

+                return new + path[len(old):]

+        return path

+

+    def changed(self):

+        """(old path, new path, old text, new text) of every file whose content changed."""

+        for path in sorted(self.new_texts):

+            old_text, new_text = self.old_texts[path], self.new_texts[path]

+            if old_text != new_text:

+                yield path, self.moved(path), old_text, new_text

+

+    def to_dict(self):

+        return {

+            "changed_files": {self.relative(new): text for _, new, _, text in self.changed()},

+            "renames": {self.relative(old): self.relative(new) for old, new in self.renames},

+        }

+

+    def to_diff(self):

+        parts = []

+        for old, new in self.renames:

+            parts.append(f"rename from {self.relative(old)}\nrename to {self.relative(new)}\n")

+        for old_path, new_path, old_text, new_text in self.changed():

+            old_lines = _diff_lines(old_text)

+            new_lines = _diff_lines(new_text)

+            parts.append("".join(difflib.unified_diff(

+                old_lines, new_lines, fromfile=self.relative(old_path),

+                tofile=self.relative(new_path))))

+def _diff_lines(text):

+    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)

+            return ast.parse(text)

+class Source:

+    """A file being refactored: its text, lines, strict syntax tree and parent links."""

+    def __init__(self, path):

+        self.path = os.path.abspath(path)

+        self.text = document.text

+        self.document = document

+        self.tree = parse_strict(self.text, path)

+        self.parents = {}

+        for parent in ast.walk(self.tree):

+            for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):

+                self.parents[id(child)] = parent

+        offsets = [0]

+        for line in self.lines:

+            offsets.append(offsets[-1] + len(line) + 1)

+        self._offsets = offsets

+

+    # positions: (1-based line, 0-based character column) <-> absolute offsets

+

+    def offset(self, line, col):

+        return self._offsets[line - 1] + col

+

+    def position(self, offset):

+        line = 1

+        while line < len(self._offsets) - 1 and self._offsets[line] <= offset:

+            line += 1

+        return line, offset - self._offsets[line - 1]

+

+    def char_col(self, line, byte_col):

+        encoded = self.lines[line - 1].encode("utf-8")

+        return len(encoded[:byte_col].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))

+

+    def start(self, node):

+        """Absolute offset of the start of `node`."""

+        return self.offset(node.lineno, self.char_col(node.lineno, node.col_offset))

+

+    def end(self, node):

+        return self.offset(node.end_lineno, self.char_col(node.end_lineno, node.end_col_offset))

+

+    def segment(self, node):

+        return self.text[self.start(node):self.end(node)]

+

+    def parent(self, node):

+        return self.parents.get(id(node))

+

+    def indent_of(self, line):

+        text = self.lines[line - 1]

+        return text[:len(text) - len(text.lstrip())]

+

+def apply_edits(text, edits):

+    """Apply non-overlapping (start, end, replacement) edits to `text`."""

+    for start, end, replacement in sorted(edits, key=lambda e: (e[0], e[1]), reverse=True):

+        text = text[:start] + replacement + text[end:]

+    return text

+

+

+# -- comparing syntax trees ----------------------------------------------------------

+

+def dump(tree):

+    return ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False)

+

+

+def replaced_tree(tree, targets):

+    """A copy of `tree` with nodes replaced: `targets` maps id(old node) -> new node."""

+    nodes = list(ast.walk(tree))

+    indexes = {id(node): index for index, node in enumerate(nodes)}

+    duplicate = copy.deepcopy(tree)

+    copies = list(ast.walk(duplicate))

+    replacements = {id(copies[indexes[old]]): new for old, new in targets.items()}

+    for parent in copies:

+        for field, value in ast.iter_fields(parent):

+            if isinstance(value, list):

+                for index, item in enumerate(value):

+                    if id(item) in replacements:

+                        value[index] = copy.deepcopy(replacements[id(item)])

+            elif id(value) in replacements:

+                setattr(parent, field, copy.deepcopy(replacements[id(value)]))

+    return duplicate

+def same_tree(text, expected_dump):

+    """True when `text` parses to the tree dumped as `expected_dump`."""

+    try:

+        with warnings.catch_warnings():

+            warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

+            return dump(ast.parse(text)) == expected_dump

+    except (SyntaxError, ValueError):

+"""The `rename` command: rename a symbol (or a module) and every reference to it."""

+import os

+

+from .errors import SithError

+from .references import PROJECT, search_references

+from .refactoring import Refactoring, apply_edits, check_identifier

+from .scopes import CLASS, Binding

+from .values import LocalClass

+

+# Occurrence kinds that bind the name they spell.

+_BINDING_KINDS = ("def", "param", "bound")

+

+

+def rename(path, line, col, new_name, project=None):

+    check_identifier(new_name)

+    search = search_references(path, line, col, scope=PROJECT, project=project)

+    occurrence = search.occurrence

+    if occurrence.kind == "constant":

+        raise SithError(f"no name at line {line}, column {col}")

+    old_name = occurrence.name

+    refactoring = Refactoring(search.root)

+    kinds = {symbol[0] for symbol in search.target}

+    if kinds & {"builtin", "runtime"}:

+        raise SithError(f"cannot rename {old_name!r}: it is defined outside the project")

+    modules = [symbol[1] for symbol in search.target if symbol[0] == "module"]

+    if modules:

+        _rename_module(search, modules[0], old_name, new_name, refactoring)

+    elif new_name != old_name:

+        _check_collisions(search, new_name)

+    if new_name == old_name:

+        return refactoring

+    edits = {}

+    for match in search.matches:

+        context = match.navigator.context

+        start = match.occurrence.start

+        if context.lines[match.line - 1][start:start + len(old_name)] != old_name:

+            continue

+        files = edits.setdefault(match.path, (context.text, set()))

+        files[1].add(_offset(context.lines, match.line, start))

+    for file_path, (old_text, starts) in edits.items():

+        new_text = apply_edits(old_text, [(s, s + len(old_name), new_name) for s in starts])

+        refactoring.change(file_path, old_text, new_text)

+    return refactoring

+

+

+def _offset(lines, line, col):

+    return sum(len(text) + 1 for text in lines[:line - 1]) + col

+

+

+def _rename_module(search, location, old_name, new_name, refactoring):

+    """Rename the file or directory of a project module."""

+    importer = search.importer

+    location = os.path.abspath(location)

+    if not importer.within_project(os.path.dirname(location)) or \

+            importer.within_project(location) and location.startswith(importer.stub_dir + os.sep):

+        raise SithError(f"cannot rename module {old_name!r}: it is outside the project")

+    if os.path.isdir(location):

+        old_path = location

+    elif os.path.basename(location) in ("__init__.py", "__init__.pyi"):

+        old_path = os.path.dirname(location)

+    else:

+        old_path = location

+    base = os.path.basename(old_path)

+    stem, extension = (base, "") if os.path.isdir(old_path) else os.path.splitext(base)

+    if stem != old_name:

+        raise SithError(f"cannot rename module {stem!r} through the name {old_name!r}")

+    if new_name == old_name:

+        return

+    directory = os.path.dirname(old_path)

+    new_path = os.path.join(directory, new_name + extension)

+    for candidate in (os.path.join(directory, new_name), os.path.join(directory, new_name + ".py"),

+                      os.path.join(directory, new_name + ".pyi")):

+        if os.path.exists(candidate):

+            raise SithError(f"cannot rename module {old_name!r} to {new_name!r}: "

+                            f"{os.path.relpath(candidate, search.root)} already exists")

+    refactoring.rename(old_path, new_path)

+

+

+def _check_collisions(search, new_name):

+    """Refuse renames that would clash with a name already bound where the symbol is used."""

+    navigator = search.navigator

+    try:

+        sources = navigator.goto(search.occurrence)

+    except Exception:

+        sources = []

+    for source in sources:

+        owner = source.extra.get("owner") if isinstance(source, Binding) else None

+        if owner is not None and _class_binds(search, owner, new_name):

+            _collision(search, new_name, owner)

+    for match in search.matches:

+        current = match.navigator

+        occurrence = match.occurrence

+        if occurrence.kind in ("attr", "kwarg", "module", "imported"):

+            continue

+        current.at(match.line, occurrence.start)

+        binding = current.context.binding_of(occurrence.node) \

+            if occurrence.kind in _BINDING_KINDS and occurrence.node is not None else None

+        if binding is not None:

+            if new_name in binding.scope.bindings or \

+                    binding.scope.kind == CLASS and _class_binds(search, binding.scope, new_name):

+                _collision(search, new_name, binding.scope)

+            continue

+        scope = current.scope()

+        for candidate in scope.chain():

+            if candidate.kind == CLASS and candidate is not scope:

+                continue

+            if new_name in candidate.bindings:

+                _collision(search, new_name, candidate)

+

+

+def _class_binds(search, scope, name):

+    if name in scope.bindings:

+        return True

+    members = search.inferrer.members

+    try:

+        return name in members.instance_attribute_bindings(LocalClass(scope))

+    except Exception:

+        return False

+

+

+def _collision(search, new_name, scope):

+    node = scope.node

+    where = f"{node.name!r}" if hasattr(node, "name") else "the module"

+    if scope.kind == "module":

+        where = search.factory.relative_path(scope.module.path) or "the module"

+    raise SithError(f"cannot rename to {new_name!r}: the name {new_name!r} already exists "

+                    f"in the scope of {where}")
